title: W1: team tasks, actions, work reports and decisions as frozen contracts with pure rules
request: The owner approved the collaborative workspace plan; package W1 asks for the records that travel between team agents and the rules that keep their reports honest, in dclab_core.
spec: dclab_core/team_work.py: TeamTask, TeamAction, WorkReport, TeamDecision, AgentConfig with DIRECTORY, TeamWork (dclab_core.team_work.v1); validate_transition, may_take, can_claim, accept_reply, join_status, build_report, supersede, next_owner, may_approve; schemas, changelog, integration section, wheel check.
plan: read the owner's plan and the approved package list
write the records and the rules as pure pydantic
write the owner's examples as tests
register the contracts, generate schemas, bump the version, document
run the contract, conformance and wheel checks

decisions.decision: Each record is its own versioned contract, plus one TeamWork bundle named dclab_core.team_work.v1
decisions.why: the contract test requires every contract name to match its schema_version, and the W4 store keeps tasks, actions and reports as separate rows

decisions.decision: A correction is a new report revision on the same task, linked both ways by supersede()
decisions.why: the plan deduplicates replies by task and report revision, and the unaffected acceptance report must keep its own snapshot untouched

decisions.decision: join_status and build_report take the child tasks as a keyword argument
decisions.why: the parent record does not list its children, so naming the outstanding one needs the children; without them nothing can be called outstanding

decisions.decision: WorkReport carries parent_task_id and brief_revision copied from its task
decisions.why: accept_reply must refuse another branch and an obsolete brief revision from the report alone, at delivery time

decisions.decision: Home, Lead and Advisor are configured as specialists
decisions.why: the brief allows two kinds (team agent or specialist) and these roles act inside a team's conversation, not as a team

change: dclab_core/team_work.py (new), dclab_core/schemas.py (import), dclab_core/adapters/conformance.py (six library-only entries), dclab_core/schemas/*.json and baseline v1 files for team_task, team_action, work_report, team_decision, agent_config, team_work, dclab_core/CHANGELOG.md, pyproject.toml and __init__.py (0.164.0), docs/guides/CORE_INTEGRATION.md, tests/test_core_team_work.py.

findings.defect: Every new contract failed the conformance gate until it had an adapter or a library-only reason.
findings.scenario: test_conformance.py listed 'contract agent_config: no adapter and no reason' for the six new contracts.
findings.cause: conformance.problems() requires every registered contract in CONTRACT_ADAPTERS.
findings.fix: six LIBRARY entries naming why the pinned main product has no field for them

findings.defect: delegate() let a blocked task open a child task, a move the state machine never allows.
findings.scenario: A blocked Data Science task delegating to a model specialist would create a child while the parent could not wait on it.
findings.cause: the first check only refused closed and unaccepted parents
findings.fix: only an accepted, waiting_for_team or partial parent delegates

findings.defect: test_store.py fails on dclab_rnd/store/writers.py line 135, which joins a store path itself.
findings.scenario: Running test_store.py beside this package's tests; the file is unchanged since commit c0021683.
findings.cause: an earlier change, not part of this package
findings.fix: none here: out of this package's files

findings.defect: A private team note reached the shared report through fields the check did not read.
findings.scenario: A skipped action's reason, a failure reference, next_task.unblocks and an evidence input_revision all quoting the Sales note survived build_report.
findings.cause: _quotes read only the answer, limits and some evidence fields
findings.fix: every action reason, output and failure, the next step and every evidence field are read; a quoting report is refused, never silently edited

findings.defect: A parent could complete, and report complete, with a child still outstanding.
findings.scenario: validate_transition moved the dispatch task to complete with both model children out; build_report joined a child report with no children list, and a partial child report counted.
findings.cause: the transition never looked at children and build_report trusted the reports it was given
findings.fix: validate_transition takes children and child_reports and refuses complete while one is out; build_report refuses child reports without children; a partial child is never a result

findings.defect: accept_reply accepted a superseded report and a revision older than one already joined.
findings.scenario: ETA r1 arriving after r2 was joined, on the same brief revision, was accepted; so was r1 after supersede marked it superseded.
findings.cause: only the brief revision and the exact id were compared
findings.fix: a superseded report, or one whose task already has a joined revision at or above it (parsed from task@rN), is refused as obsolete

findings.defect: One action could appear twice in a report, and one side effect could be claimed twice.
findings.scenario: The same TeamAction passed twice was listed twice; two succeeded records with different ids and one retry_key were both listed as completed.
findings.cause: build_report listed every record it was given
findings.fix: one record per action id (a planned record followed by its terminal one collapses; two terminal ones conflict); two completed records sharing a retry key are refused

findings.defect: supersede could overwrite an existing link or chain from a superseded report.
findings.scenario: supersede(r1, r3) where r3 already superseded r2 rewrote r3.supersedes to r1; a superseded r2 could replace r1.
findings.cause: only the old report's link was checked
findings.fix: refuse a new report that already replaces another, and one that is itself superseded

findings.defect: A report said complete for a task still accepted or blocked.
findings.scenario: An accepted Data Science task with one finished action got a complete report; a blocked task accepted status='complete'.
findings.cause: the derived status ignored the task's own status unless it was blocked or failed
findings.fix: complete is derived only when the task is complete, partial otherwise; an explicit complete needs a complete task

findings.defect: A stored WorkReport did not enforce the rules build_report applies.
findings.scenario: A report with a simulated action line and simulated=False, and a complete report with no completed action and no child, both validated when read from storage.
findings.cause: the rules lived only in build_report

findings.defect: An agent could be a decision owner or approver, and an action's actor kind was not checked.
findings.scenario: A decision owned and approved by 'business' validated; a person named 'data_science' passed may_take; record_decision had no person behind its human source.
findings.cause: approval and owner were plain strings; may_take compared names only
findings.fix: decision_owner and Approval.who are Actors that must be persons; may_take needs an agent actor; TeamAction.responded_by names the person behind a completed human-bound action (W5 checks the role)

findings.defect: Evidence and tools outside a task's allowed inputs and tools were reported.
findings.scenario: A task allowed only crm.renewals and inspect_schema still reported billing.invoices evidence and a check_leakage tool action.
findings.cause: allowed_inputs and allowed_tools were stored but never read
findings.fix: build_report refuses evidence from another source and an action through another tool when the task lists them

findings.defect: A child on an older brief revision was joined, and children could overspend their parent.
findings.scenario: A child report on brief 1 joined a parent at brief 2; two children each given the parent's whole 1.0 EUR were both created.
findings.cause: join_status ignored brief revisions and delegate checked each child alone
findings.fix: join_status and build_report refuse a current child report older than the parent's brief; delegate takes siblings and budget_fits checks the sum

measurements.name: dclab_core wheel built and used in a clean Python 3.12
measurements.gate: make core-wheel-check status passed with no unexpected distributions
measurements.next: W2 teams and membership in the R&D host
limits: the wheel smoke run does not call team_work itself
no model is involved in W1

outcome: The team work records and rules exist as six v1 contracts with the owner's examples passing as tests; nothing in the host uses them yet.
lessons: A rule that needs to name what is missing needs the list of what was expected, not only what arrived.
An honesty rule enforced only in the builder is not a rule of the record: a stored report must refuse what the builder refuses.
risks: accept_reply refuses any reply on an older brief revision, even one a correction did not affect; which tasks a correction affects is W6's job.
validate_transition and delegate check children and budgets only when the caller passes them; W4's store must always pass the parent's children.
That responded_by holds the bound human role (decision owner, requester) is the host's check in W5, not this module's.
